articles.title: Star from 'The Breakfast Club' looks unrecognizable with long beard and hair in rare public sighting
articles.summary: Judd Nelson was spotted riding a motorcycle in West Hollywood, sporting a long beard and long hair that left the Brat Pack star unrecognizable.
articles.body: Former Brat Pack member Judd Nelson looked unrecognizable when spotted during a rare outing earlier this week. The 66-year-old star was photographed while out-and-about in West Hollywood. He was photographed driving around town in his motorcycle, which featured yellow rims and accents throughout. In the photos, Nelson sported a long beard and long hair, which he covered with either a gray baseball cap or a black helmet. He kept things casual in a pair of camo pants, a red and blue flannel shirt, layered with a long black coat, which he accessorized with a pair of black sunglasses. ROB LOWE EMBRACES BRAT PACK LABEL AFTER REVEALING NICKNAME WAS ‘DESIGNED TO BELITTLE’ FAMOUS GROUP Nelson rose to fame in the 1980s as a member of the infamous Brat Pack, which was a nickname given to a group of young actors who frequently appeared in movies together throughout the decade. The term was a play on the Rat Pack, which referred to a group of Las Vegas entertainers who often performed together in the 1950s and '60s, including Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin and Sammy Davis Jr. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE Other members include Nelson's "The Breakfast Club" co-stars Emilio Estevez, Molly Ringwald, Ally Sheedy and Anthony Michael Hall, as well as Demi Moore, Andrew McCarthy and Rob Lowe. The term was coined by writer David Blum, who named the group of actors in a June 1985 article for New York Magazine, after both "St. Elmo's Fire" and "The Breakfast Club" were released in the same year and featured many of the same cast members. "Whereas my experience was everyone was on time. Everyone knows their lines. It’s so weird." He also found it "weird" that the article made it seem as if the members of the Brat Pack were good friends, saying, "I lived in New York, then I did a movie with people out here [in L.A.]" and then once he was back in New York he lost touch. Nelson refused to participate in the documentary, explaining, "I don’t even know who’s in the Brat Pack." "It’s like, why kind of rebirth something that wasn’t necessarily fun?" he said. articles.title: World-record bluefin tuna caught off the coast of San Diego on rod and reel by sport fisherman
articles.summary: A record 446-pound giant bluefin tuna was reeled in off San Diego on a rod and reel, and the massive catch is now being served as local sashimi.
articles.body: Fans of sushi in the San Diego area rejoice, as a world record bluefin tuna was reeled in off the Southern California coast earlier this week. Markus Medak of Shearwater Fishing was able to snag the nearly 500-pound beast with the help of a fellow unnamed fisherman, on just a rod and reel. According to the New York Post, the tuna weighed in at a staggering 446 pounds after being gilled and gutted, making it the largest bluefin ever caught on a rod and reel. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! The fish was then brought to Tunaville Market and Grocery in Point Loma, which sells to local San Diego restaurants. Medak and his buddy could hardly believe their eyes when the monster catch got close to the boat. SEA LION PULLS OFF BRAZEN TUNA HEIST AS FISHERMAN TRIES AND FAILS TO HOLD ONTO HIS FIRST BIG CATCH "We both got a look at it, and we didn’t even say anything," he told a local FOX affiliate. Tommy Gomes, the owner of the Tunaville Market and Grocery, was thrilled to see the catch being brought to his doorstep, calling it a "big deal for the City of San Diego and for sportfishing." "There’s a saying, ‘The world needs more tackle boxes and less Xboxes.’ We need to teach kids how to fish," he said. Truer words have never been spoken. Gomes says this year’s "Super El Niño" could have helped with ushering the record-breaking bluefin to SoCal, as the weather phenomenon may be bringing more exotic sea creatures to the Pacific coast. The fish was reportedly broken down in a live demonstration at a local restaurant on Thursday evening. A representative for the restaurant assured that every part of the tuna will be used, even its spinal fluid, considered a delicacy in some cultures. You'll either snag the catch of a lifetime, or enjoy some damn good sashimi at a local restaurant in the process.

articles.title: Serie A had zero penalties or VAR reviews for first 31 games
articles.summary: It took until the 32nd match of the Serie A season for the first penalty to be awarded, using the first VAR On-Field Review, and the 34th match before a spot...
articles.body:
It took until the 32 nd match of the Serie A season for the first penalty to be awarded, using the first VAR On-Field Review, and the 34 th match before a spot-kick was converted.

The AIA (Italian Referees Association) had warned everyone it was going into the 2026/27 campaign laying down new guidelines after years of criticism that there were too many stoppages, too many weak penalties and red cards.

MILAN, ITALY – AUGUST 22: Referee Livio Marinelli looks on during the Serie A match between FC Internazionale and AC Monza at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on August 22, 2026 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)

While VAR was thoroughly embraced by Italian football a lot more than elsewhere, the complaint was that too many incidents were being zoomed in and judged on slow-motion replays rather than taking into account the speed and intensity of the match in context.

Serie A transformed refereeing standards

PISA, ITALY – MARCH 2: General view of the VAR monitor inside the Arena Garibaldi stadium in Pisa during the Serie A match between Pisa SC and Bologna FC 1909 at Arena Garibaldi on March 2, 2026 in Pisa, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images)

It has certainly been a shift in evaluation, because the first 31 matches in Serie A this season had not a single penalty awarded, nor a VAR On-Field Review recommended.

Arguably, the handball incident during Genoa's 1-1 draw with Frosinone falls under the remit of situations considered not clear and obvious errors, as the hand wasn't visibly moving towards the ball.

It didn't matter anyway, because after it was awarded, Lorenzo Colombo promptly side-footed the penalty wide of the target for Genoa .

BERGAMO, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 12: Daniel Maldini of Cagliari Calcio scores their team's second from the penalty spot goal during the Serie A match between Atalanta BC and Parma Calcio at Stadio Atleti Azzurri d'Italia on September 12, 2026 in Bergamo, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)

We had to wait until the 34 th match of the campaign to see a spot-kick converted, with Daniel Maldini scoring against his parent club Atalanta for the 2-1 Cagliari victory.

That was also for handball, although in this case the referee spotted the Sead Kolasinac flailing arm above the head in real time.

ROME, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 12: Nuno Tavares of SS Lazio competes for the ball with Ruben Loftus-Cheek of AC Milan during the Serie A match between SS Lazio and AC Milan at Stadio Olimpico on September 12, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images)

Serie A is standing apart from the crowd with this new attitude, and some worry they might've over-corrected.

After all, LaLiga saw 13 penalties awarded in the opening 30 matches , nine in Ligue 1, five in the Premier League, and just one in the Bundesliga.

articles.title: How to score 10 unearned runs in a game
articles.summary: This 1990 game wouldn’t have been the most aesthetically pleasing.
articles.body:
The early 1990s were famously not always a great time for the New York Yankees . The 1990 campaign where they went 67-95 is on the shortlist for the worst season in franchise history. It wasn't until George Steinbrenner's suspension that year that the team actually took time to let young players develop and make moves that would turn the team into the dynasty of the late 1990s.

That being said, they did still win games during the 1990 season. As the adage goes, just about every MLB team wins 50 games and loses 50 games, and your season is decided by how you do in the rest. One of the Yankees' 50 of 1990 — or 67 to be accurate — came on July 22nd, where they got a wild amount of help from their opponent.

On July 22, 1990 , the Yankees were in Minnesota to take on the Twins. While a year later, the Twins would win the World Series in a classic over Atlanta , the 1990 edition of the team would finish last in the AL West, with only the Yankees putting up a worse record in the American League.

On this particular day, the Twins struck first. Facing Yankees starter Andy Hawkins ( of losing no-hitter fame ), Gary Gaetti led off the second inning with a double and eventually tagged up and scored on a John Moses sacrifice fly.

Twins starter Scott Erickson started the game off with two scoreless innings, but got into some trouble in the third, only some of which was on him. Erickson did hit Roberto Kelly with a pitch to start the inning, but Minnesota shortstop Greg Gagne then threw away a Wayne Tolleson grounder to put two runners on. After a Deion Sanders single loaded the bases, Steve Sax grounded into a double play, which did score a run. Don Mattingly added another RBI single, which was followed by an Oscar Azócar two-run homer. The inning ended after that, but the Yankees had a 4-1 lead. Despite, giving up three hits, including the home run, Erickson wasn't charged with any of the runs, as they all came after that double play, which theoretically would've ended the inning had Gagne not committed his error.

While the Twins got one of those runs back in the fifth, the Yankees answered in the sixth. Azócar singled and then scored on a Matt Nokes single. However, Azócar was greatly aided in that feat by a error by Minnesota right fielder Shane Mack, as his throw to third hit a sliding Azócar.

After that though, the Twins began chipping away at the Yankees' lead. They scored one in the sixth and knocked out Hawkins. Hall of Famer Kirby Puckett was part of the action as they scored two more in the seventh to tie things up. Then in the eighth, Mack atoned for his error with an RBI triple that gave Minnesota the lead and put them three outs away from a victory. While they didn't get charged for an error themselves in this one, the Yankees made a defensive miscue of their own in this inning. Pitching Greg Cadaret had Gagne — who scored on the hit — picked off, but the Yankees botched the ensuing run down, allowing Gagne to get back to first safely, and then eventually come around on the Mack triple.

Jim Leyritz started the rally for the Yankees by leading off the frame with a single. Then, once again, the Twins' defense cost them. On back-to-back plays, third baseman Gary Gaetti and first baseman Kent Hrbek — who made a bold attempt to get a force out at third on a bunt — committed an error each. The latter of those two brought home two Yankee runners to put them back in front. The inning was hardly over there either. Steve Sax and Bob Geren each recorded RBI hits in the inning, as the Yankees put up a five-spot in total, going up 10-6. The inning also only ended because Geren got thrown out trying to stretch his hit into a double. Once again on the "the inning was only still going because of the errors" rule, all five once again went down as unearned ones.

Dave Righetti then came in for the bottom of the ninth. After all that, he needed just 10 pitches to record a 1-2-3 inning and seal the win.

If you've been paying attention, you may have noticed that, despite the Yankees reaching double digits, Twins pitchers never actually gave up an earned run in the game, thanks to the errors. Erickson's ERA went from 3.72 to 3.15 despite being on the mound for five Yankee runs. Reliever Rick Aguilera's ERA went down a bit even though he got just one of the six batters he faced out and was credited with five unearned runs. If you don't count games from before like 1920 when gloves were in their infancy and every team made like four errors a game (that's only a slight exaggeration), 10 is the most runs a Yankee team has scored in a game where they all went down as unearned.

After the game, the Yankees were in a good mood in what had been a tough season. Sax was quoted as saying "We were talking on the bench, we need to run off about 10 in a row, get close to .500."

He wasn't exactly doing the math correctly, as that win got them to 34-57, which is a bit more than 10 away from .500. Still though, they weren't the biggest screwups on the field that day.

articles.title: Country singer Brian 'Nashville' Duckworth, voice behind family band Taylor Made, dies at 56
articles.summary: Brian "Nashville" Duckworth performed with family band Taylor Made and scored a Billboard hit before his death at age 56 at his home on Sept. 7.
articles.body: Country singer Brian "Nashville" Duckworth has died at the age of 56. According to an obituary shared by his family, the singer died at his home Sept. 7. His family, with whom Duckworth was part of the band Taylor Made, shared in the obituary that, while pursuing a career as a country music star, he "was a devoted dump truck driver for Wolfe’s Excavating," earning him the nickname, "Truck Boss." They added that "he truly enjoyed" the job "because it allowed him to spend his days outdoors." "Music was also a special part of his life. He loved to sing and proudly performed with his family band, Taylor Made. Brian never passed up an opportunity to share his voice, earning him the affectionate nickname 'Nashville.'" DOLLY PARTON'S SISTER REVEALS ‘LAST THING’ COUNTRY LEGEND ASKED OF HER BEFORE DEATH Duckworth grew up signing with his brother, Greg, and his sister, Wendy Williams, with the trio coming together in 2008 to form the band I-79 performing under that name for the first time at the Colgate Country Showdown. They later changed their name to Taylor Made and made a name for themselves with hit songs such as "Things You Don’t Grow Out Of," which reached No. 36 on the Billboard Indicator chart. He is survived by his wife of nearly 16 years, Tina, his six children, Zach, Ashton, Logan, Kayla, Michael and Matt, as well as his four grandchildren and five brothers and sisters. "Above all, Brian treasured his family and the special memories they created together," the obituary read. "He also dearly loved his faithful fur family, who were constant companions and brought him great comfort and happiness. Brian’s love of family, music, and the outdoors will forever remain in the hearts of all who knew and loved him." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE His niece, Brianna Duckworth Kazner, shared a video on her Facebook account from her wedding, saying she is "having a hard time believing" that is "the last time Taylor Made sang together." "I grew up watching my dad, Aunt Wendy, and Uncle Brian perform at fairs and festivals until I was finally old enough to join them on a few occasions," Kazner wrote. "As I’ve gotten older and started writing my own music, I knew the guy to call whenever I got creatively ‘stuck.’ He truly had such a way with song lyrics that I knew without a doubt Uncle Brian would pull me out of the songwriter’s slump." O 15º Festival Gastronômico de Macaé reúne gastronomia, inclusão e tecnologia na Orla dos Cavaleiros. A estrutura oferece iniciativas gratuitas de acessibilidade, conectividade e entretenimento para públicos de diferentes idades. Os espaços seguem disponíveis neste domingo (13), último dia do evento.

Entre as ações está o Espaço de Regulação Sensorial, ambiente lúdico e tranquilo preparado para oferecer momentos de pausa em meio ao movimento do festival. Com abafadores de ruído, objetos interativos e suporte de profissionais de saúde, o local acolhe crianças, jovens e adultos que precisam de apoio para a autorregulação sensorial.

Interatividade com robô e acesso gratuito à internet movimentam a estrutura do evento — Foto: Arquivo Secom

A conectividade também está presente na Sala de Notebook – Wi-Fi Macaé. O espaço disponibiliza computadores e acesso gratuito à internet, permitindo que moradores e visitantes utilizem a rede pública durante a passagem pelo evento.

Outro destaque é o robô humanoide, que circula pelo festival com apresentações interativas. A atração aproxima crianças e famílias do universo da ciência e da tecnologia de maneira lúdica.

As iniciativas funcionam de forma integrada à programação gastronômica e cultural e ampliam as opções disponíveis ao público. Neste domingo, o festival funciona das 13h às 21h, com entrada gratuita e classificação livre. Menores de 14 anos devem estar acompanhados por um responsável.

O rapper carioca Sant lança o álbum 'O que separam os meninos dos homens vol. II' na próxima quarta-feira, 16 de setembro — Foto: Ciro Neves / Divulgação

♬ Em novembro de 2025, dez anos após ter lançado “O que separa os homens dos meninos” (2015), EP com cinco músicas, o rapper carioca Sant anunciou a sequência do projeto fonográfico e antecipou a faixa “Meio”, gravada com L7nnon e com produção musical de MC Marechal, nome recorrente nas faixas do EP de 2015.

Dez meses depois do anúncio, Sant enfim lança “O que separa os homens dos meninos vol. II”. Desta vez não é um EP, mas um álbum com onze faixas que será apresentado na próxima quarta-feira, 16 de setembro.

A cantora Céu participa do álbum e faz feat com Sant na música “Vida real”. O rapper Emicida reforça o time de convidados da sequência, soltando a voz na música-título “O que separa os homens dos meninos II”.

O álbum “O que separa os homens dos meninos vol. II” é a segunda parte de uma trilogia que será concluída por Sant em data ainda incerta.

articles.summary: Halsey, Lola Young, Marina Sena convida Céu, Ivete Sangalo e Joelma convida Viviane Batidão também integram o line-up. Saiba como serão os shows.
articles.body:
Zara Larsson, Twenty One Pilots e Halsey estão entre atrações do Rock in Rio no dia 13 de setembro — Foto: Reprodução

Neste domingo (13), último dia de Rock in Rio 2026, o line-up dos palcos principais é quase inteiramente feminino. A exceção fica por conta dos headliners do Palco Mundo: a dupla Twenty One Pilots, que costuma fazer um show bem enérgico com repertório de rock alternativo.

No Palco Sunset, a sueca Zara Larsson é a principal atração. A cantora veio ao Brasil dois anos atrás, quando foi somente a segunda atração do Palco Mundo; agora, ela vem com um dos shows mais aguardados da edição. Tudo graças ao disco "Midnight Sun", que tem hits divertidos e rendeu apresentações lotadas em todo o mundo.

A americana Halsey também se apresenta hoje, no Palco Mundo. A cantora vem com o disco "The Great Impersonator", com repertório eclético, voltado para o pop rock. A britânica Lola Young, do hit "Messy", também promete entregar um ótimo show com seu belo vozeirão.

Ivete Sangalo, Marina Sena convida Céu, Joelma convida Viviane Batidão e Carol Biazin convida Joyce Alane também integram o line-up.

O festival será transmitido ao vivo nos dias 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 12 e 13 de setembro, a partir das 15h15, pelo Multishow, e a partir das 15h50, pelo Canal Bis, e para assinantes do plano Premium do Globoplay, que também terão acesso à transmissão do Multishow em 4K, por meio de um sinal extra.

Quem não é assinante também poderá acompanhar os cinco palcos do Rock in Rio pelo sinal aberto, que irá se revezar entre Multishow e Bis a cada 30 minutos, a partir das 15h30. A TV Globo exibe flashes durante a programação e um especial todas as noites - às sextas (4 e 11/9), após o Globo Repórter; aos sábados (5 e 12/9), após o Altas Horas; aos domingos (6 e 13/9), após o Boletim Estrelas da Casa, e na segunda (7/9), após o Jornal da Globo.

articles.title: 'Reacher' star Alan Ritchson and wife Catherine splitting up after 2 decades of marriage
articles.summary: Alan Ritchson and wife Catherine announced their split after 20 years of marriage, vowing to co-parent their three sons with grace and friendship.
articles.body: Alan Ritchson and his wife have decided to go their separate ways. In a joint Instagram post shared on Saturday, the 43-year-old actor and his wife Catherine announced they have "decided to end our marriage and continue alongside one another in a different way" after 20 years together. "We grew up together. We built a life and a family together. And we are raising three incredible boys who will always be the center of our world," they wrote. The film's total India net collection has now reached Rs 192.13 cr. Its India gross collection stands at Rs 227.00 cr.The overseas market has added Rs 5.00 cr to the film's Day 37 earnings. The Day 37 collection represents a 76.2% growth over the previous day's earnings.Vishal Chaturvedi film crosses Rs 192 cr in India netThe film's weekly figures show how its box-office performance strengthened after the opening weeks. articles.title: Oscar-winning ‘The Last Emperor’ film producer Jeremy Thomas passes away at 77
articles.summary: Jeremy Thomas, the Oscar-winning producer known for ‘The Last Emperor’ and ‘Sexy Beast,’ has passed away at the age of 77. Tributes pour in as the film industry mourns a legendary figure who shaped independent cinema.
articles.body: Jeremy Thomas, best known for his work on ‘The Last Emperor’ and ‘Sexy Beast,' has passed away. The Oscar-winning film producer, who had worked in the film industry for decades, left for his heavenly abode at the age of 77.Jeremy Thomas passes away at 77BBC reported the news, sharing that Jeremy Thomas passed away at his home in Oxfordshire on Friday. His publicist confirmed the news in an official statement, sharing that he "passed away peacefully" and was surrounded by his family and loved ones at the time. No other details about his passing were shared with the public at the time of writing.Tributes pour in for Jeremy ThomasSoon after the news of his passing circulated online, tributes and well wishes for the late star started pouring in.Thomas’ co-star from ‘Tideland’ and ‘The Man Who Killed Don Quixote,' Terry Gilliam, issued a statement to Variety about the veteran’s passing and shared, “Jeremy Thomas loved making movies. He loved every aspect of the business, but most of all he loved directors. The list of those he worked with is almost endless, and I was one of the lucky ones. His taste in filmmaking spanned the globe.” He further added, “Filmmaking is not cheap, and the pressures are intense, but Jeremy always remained calm and supportive. He was a rare and very unique gem in the world of producers.”Producer Stephen Woolley looked back on the time he met the producer for the first time and shared, “Jeremy Thomas was the person in 1981 in Japan who didn’t suggest but insisted that I be a film producer!!!! He was a huge inspiration and a massively undervalued genius and necessary rebel in our industry… he sided with the subversives and movie anarchists, and we loved him dearly… and I have to thank him for my career following in similar footsteps, avoiding nationalistic stereotypes and embracing the world of cinema.”Who was Jeremy ThomasJeremy Thomas was a well-known producer, filmmaker, and editor who dedicated around five decades of his life to the film industry. Jeremy Thomas was born on July 26, 1949, in London, England. He came from a film background, as his father was director Ralph Thomas, who worked on many ‘Doctor’ films. His uncle Gerald Thomas was well known for directing all the films in the ‘Carry On’ franchise.He was a pioneering force in the film industry, backing indie projects and working with several renowned directors throughout his career. This included names like Nagisa Oshima, David Cronenberg, Julien Temple, Ben Wheatley, Jonathan Glazer, Stephen Frears, David Mackenzie, and Nicolas Roeg, to name a few. He was also a well-decorated producer in the film industry who won around nine Academy Awards over the past five decades. Some of his other work included projects like ‘The Sheltering Sky,' ‘Little Buddha,' ‘Merry Christmas, Mr Lawrence,' ‘A Dangerous Method,' ‘Bad Method,' 'Eureka,' ‘The Great Rock 'n' Roll Swindle,' ‘Stealing Beauty,' and ‘The Dreamers.'Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Reacher’ star Alan Ritchson and wife Catherine confirm split after 20 years: ‘We built a life and a family together…’
articles.summary: Famed actor Alan Ritchson, best known for his ongoing series 'Reacher,' has confirmed that he and his wife, Catherine, have mutually agreed to part wa.
articles.body: Famed actor Alan Ritchson, best known for his ongoing series 'Reacher,' has confirmed that he and his wife, Catherine, have mutually agreed to part ways. The two are calling it quits on their marriage after being together for almost 20 years. On Saturday, the two took to Instagram to share the news that they were parting ways after nearly 20 years together. They shared a lengthy and emotional statement on Instagram detailing how they mutually reached the decision.Alan Ritchson and Catherine announce a split after 20 yearsTheir post read, “After twenty years together, Cat and I have decided to end our marriage and continue alongside one another in a different way. We grew up together. We built a life and a family together. And we are raising three incredible boys who will always be the center of our world."They also wrote that they still have a lot of love and respect for one another and that the years they spent together are truly cherished. “The best gift we can give one another—and our boys—right now is friendship, grace, and a commitment to becoming the strongest co-parents we can be. We also want to give each other room to grow into the people we are becoming," the statement added.Asking fans for some distance and privacy in the matter, the couple concluded their post by mentioning, “We hope, especially for the sake of our boys, that you will allow our family to move through this chapter with privacy and compassion. Thanks for supporting us as we continue making the health and happiness of our family our priority.” Lastly, they signed the post-off as “Alan and Cat."In another report that was later shared online by TMZ, it was revealed that the 43-year-old actor had earlier filed for divorce in December last year. The outlet further stated that the two had reconciled in March earlier this year; however, they have now come to the inevitable conclusion of their relationship.About Alan Ritchson and CatherineThe long-running couple had met each other for the first time when they enrolled in the same ballet class when they were teenagers. Years later, however, they reconnected when Catherine started attending the University of Florida after graduation, while Alan was visiting Miami for a modelling shoot at the time. They kept their relationship quiet and got married in 2006. Since then, while neither of them is all that public about their relationship and their family life, they have shared glimpses over the years with fans. Not only that, but they have three children: Calem, Edan, and Amory, who sometimes accompany them to work events, and the family of five has been photographed together on red carpets.In 2023, while talking on the ‘Road to Wisdom’ podcast, Catherine recalled what it was like to meet the actor all those years ago during the dance class. She had shared at the time, “I’ll never forget seeing him for the first time in the [dance] studio. I turned to my friend Miriam, and I said, "Who is that?" He, at some point, came up to me, and we just got chatting.The same year, Ritchson shared an emotional post online for their 17th anniversary as a couple, writing a dedication to his partner, adding, “Dealing with a bipolar husband who can give a sane partner severe whiplash and a level of fame that nothing can prepare you for… I wouldn’t wish on my worst enemy. Yet this is the straw she drew when she said, ‘I do.’ Thank GOD for someone with the unspeakable strength, persistence, resilience, patience, grace, love, compassion, and forgiveness to suffer through the valleys with me.”The former couple requested privacy during the difficult time.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. The pair finished three laps behind the overall winner after a challenging contest.The team had entered the race with a stronger starting position. Ajith Kumar and Romain Vozniak had qualified eighth in the LMP3 Pro/Am category earlier on Saturday.However, the qualifying result did not translate into a points-scoring finish. Ajith RedAnt by Virage could not maintain its position during the main race and eventually ended the event outside the points.Ajith RedAnt by Virage remains on 21 pointsThe Silverstone result also affected the team's immediate championship prospects.
